title: Evidence Appraisal
description: A verifier's appraisal artifact: the record of what an independent verifier actually checked about an evidence record, and the grade it concluded. The E-grade is an output of appraisal and lives here, in the verifier's artifact — never as a stamp the producer adds to its own record (RATS split: evidence in, appraisal policy is the bridge, attestation results out). Deliberately implementation-free: it records presence and conclusion, not mechanism.

record_id.description: Identifier of the evidence record being appraised.

digest.description: Content address of the appraised evidence record: SHA-256 over the JCS (RFC 8785) canonical form of the full record. Bare 64-char lowercase hex.

e_grade.description: The grade the verifier actually checked and concluded — never a depth higher than it executed. E0 Declared, E1 Observed, E2 Enforced, E3 Corroborated, E4 Anchored.

claim_type.description: Which receipt claim of the subject record was appraised.

reconciliation_state.description: The verifier's three-state reconciliation finding between the record's self-report and its own observation.

verifier_id.description: Identifier for the independent verifier that produced this appraisal.

timestamp.description: When the appraisal was performed, ISO 8601.

signed.description: Whether the appraisal itself carries a signature. Presence only, no mechanism.
